- PARTY BUNTING ranked 2 at £1,825.40 TW against £1,410.09 LW (WoW +29.5%) and £31.72 LY (YoY +5,654.7%), while SPOTTY BUNTING fell to £845.73 from £1,068.76 LW (WoW -20.9%).
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER posted £1,825.17 TW versus £1,991.04 LW (WoW -8.3%) and £3,712.01 LY (YoY -50.8%), with 150 units TW against 147 LW.

- Cold weather lines rose: HAND WARMER OWL DESIGN £1,611.60 TW (WoW +416.7%, YoY +2,458.1%), HOT WATER BOTTLE KEEP CALM £1,198.31 (WoW +72.8%) and LOVE HOT WATER BOTTLE £1,046.40 (WoW +155.1%).
- Christmas stock moved up the table: PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS £1,347.29 TW (WoW +159.0%, YoY +3,705.9%), VINTAGE CHRISTMAS BUNTING £870.00 (WoW +362.5%), STAR WOODEN CHRISTMAS DECORATION £448.16 (WoW +3,710.9%, YoY +2,322.5%) and CHRISTMAS RETROSPOT ANGEL WOOD £450.42 (WoW +1,803.7%).
- WOOD BLACK BOARD ANT WHITE FINISH dropped to £489.41 TW from £2,057.46 LW (WoW -76.2%) on 63 units versus 370 LW, though still +99.1% YoY against £245.77.
